name: Jordan Bardella
role: President of the National Rally (since 2022); MEP (since 2019); chairman of Patriots for Europe
summary: French nationalist politician who leads the National Rally. He campaigns for sharply lower immigration, national preference in social benefits, tougher sentencing and a sovereigntist but non-Frexit line on the EU, while backing business tax cuts and opposing the Green Deal.

abortion-legal.rationale: Said the Veil law must be guaranteed and protected and that he would vote to write it into the constitution, while calling the move a diversion.

citizenship-by-descent.rationale: Wants to end automatic acquisition of French nationality by birth in France ('not justified in a world of 8 billion').

collective-defense.rationale: Says that as NATO and EU members France has a duty of mutual assistance.

cut-consumption-tax.rationale: Programme suspends VAT on about a hundred necessities in times of high inflation, a conditional rather than general exemption.

direct-votes.rationale: Repeatedly proposes referendums on immigration, on Islamist ideology and on assisted reproduction.

end-foreign-alliances.rationale: Stays in NATO, opposes leaving its integrated command while war continues and affirms mutual assistance duties.

independent-nuclear-deterrent.rationale: Insists on no sharing, co-financing or co-decision on the French nuclear button.

limit-growth.rationale: Calls the Green Deal one of the biggest degrowth plans and wants all constraints on growth unlocked.

mandatory-sentences.rationale: Announced minimum sentences (peines planchers) to 'break repeat offenders' as a priority bill.

nation-first.rationale: Argues France should defend its interests as Germany does, seeking a rebate on EU contributions and a French energy price.

national-law-over-international.rationale: Says he is committed to the supremacy of the French Constitution over any international considerations.

open-borders.rationale: Wants Schengen free movement reserved to Europeans and a 'double border' that turns back migrants, the opposite of open borders.

pronatalist-incentives.rationale: Proposes a full tax share for the second child and larger tax-free gifts to children.

reduce-immigration.rationale: Calls for ending automatic droit du sol, no regularisation, expulsions without exemptions, an immigration referendum and sending home jobless foreigners.

regulate-corporations.rationale: Backs a regulatory pause for companies, simplification and repeal of the corporate due-diligence directive.

religious-dress-in-state.rationale: Said a proposal would extend the ban on religious signs from schools to the public sphere, including state institutions.

same-sex-marriage.rationale: Personally opposed same-sex marriage in 2018 but says the debate is closed and he will not seek to abolish it, so the reported position is mild opposition.

welfare-for-citizens.rationale: His programme reserves social aid for French citizens and conditions non-contributory benefits on years of work in France.

notes: Searched themes (also Corsica autonomy, LGBT rights, pensions, income tax; the Corsica and pension reports gave no answer matching a statement): immigration, citizenship, security, social benefits, religion in public life, abortion, EU and sovereignty, NATO, Ukraine, nuclear policy, climate and energy, economy (taxes, pensions), referendums. Sources are press reports of his statements (tier 5/3), so confidence is medium at most. Statements on same-sex marriage, the death penalty and pension detail have no recorded position in the sources opened, so they are null.
